$comment: Source of truth for PeachPDF's CSS/SVG property dispatch, consumed by PeachPDF.SourceGenerators to emit CssPropertyRegistry.g.cs / SvgPropertyRegistry.g.cs. See CLAUDE.md's generator section for the authoring workflow and the PPGxxx diagnostics that check this file. Every HTML/SVG property PeachPDF's renderer dispatches lives here — see docs/html-css-support.md for the reader-facing compatibility matrix this data backs.

properties.name: border-bottom-width
properties.comment: Accepts a valid length, or the auto keyword (compared case-insensitively — an existing inconsistency vs. most other keyword checks in this codebase, encoded as-is rather than silently fixed).

properties.name: transform
properties.comment: cssDataType 'cssom' keeps real dispatch exactly as permissive as before (matching actual CSS transform-list semantics: a value with one unimplemented function, e.g. perspective(), is still syntactically valid and its implemented functions still apply - see TransformIntegrationTests.Perspective_IsUnsupported_TreatedAsIdentity). supportsDataType 'transform' is the stricter, @supports-only grammar (CssValueParser.IsValidTransformValue): the real set of transform functions BuildFunctionMatrix implements at paint time. perspective() parses as valid CSS but is silently dropped at paint time, so it must not report as @supports-true even though it's still accepted and stored by real dispatch.

properties.name: box-sizing
properties.comment: Replaces the old CssUtils.IsValidBoxSizing helper.

properties.name: direction
properties.comment: TrySet/SupportsDeclaration validate the value against Map.DirectionModes' own keys (ltr/rtl, case-insensitive) via the enum-keyword data type; an unrecognized value is rejected. CssProperty<T>.FromCssText itself never rejects once a value reaches the setter — it falls back to the keyword default (ltr) — so the fallback only applies to a value that already passed validation upstream. The svg binding is a carrier-only, hand-written entry (applyIn: manual) — SVG never stores direction on SvgElement, only threads it through SvgInheritedPaint for text runs, so it is deliberately excluded from the generated SVG dispatch (see SvgTreeBuilder.ApplyCommon's manual-property section).

properties.name: page-break-after
properties.comment: Legacy alias of break-after (css-break-3 §3.3), sharing its storage; the CSS2.1 'always' keyword remaps to break-after's 'page'.

properties.name: font-family
properties.comment: Multi-field write: the resolved family (FontFamily) and the raw authored list (FontFamilyList) both come from one declaration. The initial value is UA/platform-defined (CssConstants.DefaultFont is computed per-platform at runtime), hence an {expression} rather than a string literal.

properties.name: margin-block-start
properties.comment: CSS Logical Properties (css-logical-1) resolution scratch space — CssBox.LogicalProperties.cs. Read exactly once by CssBox.ResolveLogicalProperties, which maps it to one of margin-top/-right/-bottom/-left depending on this box's own resolved direction/writing-mode; that cross-property resolution stays hand-written (a single JSON entry cannot express a function of two other properties' resolved values). No initial value by design: the physical property it resolves into already has one. Validation mirrors margin-top's (none).

properties.name: overflow-wrap
properties.comment: Grammar accepted by Layer A, deliberately unimplemented by Layer B (docs/html-css-support.md). TrySet/SupportsDeclaration correctly return false, replacing the old CssUtils dispatch's silent no-op lambda. inherited: false and initialValue: null both preserve today's actual behavior (CssDefaults never listed it as inherited, despite CSS Text 4 §3 specifying inheritance for it) rather than silently fixing a spec deviation this migration isn't scoped to touch.

properties.name: fill
properties.comment: SVG <paint> (svg-shapes-1.1 §13.2): none | url(#id) | currentColor | <color>. Produces a structured SvgPaint, not a string, so it needs its own data type rather than HTML's plain 'color'. No customSetter needed — the generated default svg-paint setter already reclassifies a url() reference from gradient to pattern against the current document's id registries via ctx.ResolveUrlPaintKind (SvgTreeBuilder.ResolveUrlPaintKind bound as a delegate); SvgValueParsers.TryParsePaint has no document context of its own and always classifies url(#id) as GradientRef.

properties.name: stroke
properties.comment: Same SVG <paint> grammar and url()-reclassification need as fill (see its comment) — stroke just targets a different SvgElement field and a different initial value/inherited carrier.

properties.name: stroke-width
properties.comment: SVG <length> (svg-strokeprops-1.1 §11.4), percentages resolved against the viewport diagonal via ctx.ViewportDiagonal. Falls back to the inherited value on an invalid value, matching SvgTreeBuilder.ApplyCommon's existing '?? inherited.StrokeWidth' behavior.

properties.name: stroke-miterlimit
properties.comment: SVG <number> (svg-strokeprops-1.1 §11.4), parsed via the shared SvgValueParsers.ParseLength grammar with no reference length (a plain unitless number is what the spec actually allows here, and ParseLength already accepts a bare number). Falls back to the inherited value on an invalid value.

properties.name: stroke-dashoffset
properties.comment: SVG <length> (svg-strokeprops-1.1 §11.4), percentages resolved against the viewport diagonal. Falls back to the inherited value on an invalid value.

properties.name: stroke-dasharray
properties.comment: SVG <length># | none (svg-strokeprops-1.1 §11.4) — SvgValueParsers.ParseDashArray already returns null (invalid) vs. an array, so this is its own data type (svg-length-list) rather than a plain length. Falls back to the inherited value on an invalid value.

properties.name: fill-rule
properties.comment: Preserves SvgValueParsers.TryParseFillRule's current silent fallback to 'nonzero' on an invalid value (invalidBehavior: leave-unset, since SvgElement's own FillRule constructor default is already Nonzero) rather than SVG 1.1 §11.4's specified fallback to the inherited value — an existing spec deviation, encoded as-is and tracked separately (see the stroke-linecap entry's identical note), not fixed by this migration. supportedValues/keywordComparison document the real grammar; customValidator/customSetter reuse the shared TryParseFillRule parser directly rather than re-deriving a keyword→enum mapping (customSetter code runs only after Validate_FillRule already passed, so the second TryParseFillRule call here can never itself fail).

properties.name: fill-opacity
properties.comment: Same shape as opacity (see its comment) — TryParseOpacity's own fallback (1.0) already equals both the initial value and SvgElement's FillOpacity constructor default, so 'leave field unwritten on failure' reproduces SvgTreeBuilder.ApplyCommon's existing present-but-invalid behavior exactly (distinct from stroke-width/etc., which fall back to inherited instead).

properties.name: stroke-opacity
properties.comment: Same shape as fill-opacity (see its comment).

properties.name: stroke-linecap
properties.comment: Preserves SvgValueParsers.TryParseLineCap's current silent fallback to 'butt' on an invalid value (invalidBehavior: leave-unset, since SvgElement's own StrokeLineCap constructor default is already Butt) rather than SVG 1.1 §11.4's specified fallback to the inherited value — an existing spec deviation, encoded as-is and tracked separately, not fixed by this migration. customValidator/customSetter reuse the shared TryParseLineCap parser directly (see the fill-rule entry's identical note) instead of the inline enum-mapping switch this entry used before the SVG cutover.

properties.name: stroke-linejoin
properties.comment: Same shape as stroke-linecap (see its comment) — TryParseLineJoin's own fallback (Miter) already equals SvgElement's StrokeLineJoin constructor default.

properties.name: opacity
properties.comment: customValidator implements <alpha-value> (css-color-4 §14): a plain number or a percentage, matching CssValueParser.ParseNumber's actual grammar (which the html setter's ActualOpacity resolution calls) rather than the cssDataType 'number' clause alone, which doesn't accept a percentage.

properties.name: break-before
properties.comment: cssDataType's own supportedValues includes region/avoid-region because real dispatch stores any css-break-4-valid keyword (CssUtilsTests.Cascade_BreakBefore_StoresOnlySpecValues) even though BreakValues.cs's fragmentation logic doesn't act on them - no FragmentationContext.Region exists, consistent with this repo's lack of multi-column-region support. supportsDataType is the stricter, @supports-only list excluding region/avoid-region for exactly that reason.

properties.name: break-inside
properties.comment: avoid-region is stored (real dispatch) like break-before/-after's region/avoid-region, but excluded from supportsDataType's stricter @supports-only list for the same reason - see break-before's comment.

properties.name: break-after
properties.comment: cssDataType's own supportedValues includes region/avoid-region because real dispatch stores any css-break-4-valid keyword (CssUtilsTests.Cascade_BreakBefore_StoresOnlySpecValues) even though BreakValues.cs's fragmentation logic doesn't act on them - no FragmentationContext.Region exists, consistent with this repo's lack of multi-column-region support. supportsDataType is the stricter, @supports-only list excluding region/avoid-region for exactly that reason.

properties.name: page-break-before
properties.comment: Legacy alias of break-before (css-break-3 §3.3); the CSS2.1 'always' keyword remaps to break-before's 'page'.

properties.name: page-break-inside
properties.comment: Legacy alias of break-inside, sharing its storage - no value remap on this axis.

properties.name: background-image
properties.comment: Parses into a structurally different field (image list) via a custom setter; cssDataType 'cssom' delegates grammar validation to the CSS-OM's own BackgroundImageProperty.

properties.name: overflow
properties.comment: 'clip' is intentionally excluded - CssUtilsTests/MonolithicContentTests confirm it isn't (and wasn't, pre-migration) an accepted value, so it never overrides the inherited/initial 'visible' and MonolithicContent.IsScrollContainer sees 'visible', not a stored 'clip'. 'auto'/'scroll' are genuinely used by MonolithicContent.IsScrollContainer (a non-visible overflow makes a box a scroll container, treated as monolithic/unbreakable across pages) even though they don't distinguish real interactive scrolling from 'hidden' - both are meaningful CSS Overflow 3 values for a non-interactive, paginated renderer.

properties.name: line-height
properties.comment: A unitless multiplier value (e.g. 'line-height: 1.5') is not modeled here and reports unsupported - IsValidLength requires a unit or a bare zero, matching ParseLength's own length-only reading at DerivedStyle.ActualLineHeight.

properties.name: text-decoration-color
properties.comment: Real color grammar now validated (was previously a documented gap: no color validation despite being a color property).

properties.name: font-weight
properties.comment: CSS Fonts 4's <number> form is validated as a plain integer (FontWeightResolver/FontResolver.PickNearestWeight use int.TryParse, not a fractional number) - no 1-1000 range is enforced by that parse itself, so the integer clause is left unbounded rather than asserting a range this codebase doesn't actually check.

properties.name: list-style-image
properties.comment: Parses into a structured field via a custom setter; cssDataType 'cssom' delegates grammar validation to the CSS-OM's own ListStyleImageProperty.

properties.name: align-items
properties.comment: supportedValues is the union of what CssLayoutEngineFlex's ComputeCrossOffsets and CssLayoutEngineGrid's ResolveSelfAlignment/AlignmentOffset each genuinely distinguish - align-items serves both layout modes and this entry can't tell which one a given box uses.

properties.name: align-self
properties.comment: Same union as align-items, plus 'auto' (defers to the container's align-items, CssLayoutEngineFlex.ComputeCrossOffsets).

properties.name: grid-template-columns
properties.comment: cssDataType 'cssom' delegates grammar validation to the CSS-OM's own GridTemplateColumnsProperty; the string setter itself is unconditional once that validation passes. TrySetTypedPropertyValue's existing hand-written _typedPropertySetters entry for this property is unaffected by this migration and is not yet superseded by a generated typed dispatch — a tracked follow-up, not a regression.

properties.name: grid-template-rows
properties.comment: cssDataType 'cssom' delegates grammar validation to the CSS-OM's own GridTemplateRowsProperty; the string setter itself is unconditional once that validation passes. TrySetTypedPropertyValue's existing hand-written _typedPropertySetters entry for this property is unaffected by this migration and is not yet superseded by a generated typed dispatch — a tracked follow-up, not a regression.

properties.name: column-span
properties.comment: cssDataType's own supportedValues includes 'all' because real dispatch stores it (ColumnSpanProperty/ColumnSpanConverter accept and round-trip it) even though CssLayoutEngineColumns.cs never reads ComputedStyleAreas.MultiColumnArea.ColumnSpan - a 'column-span: all' element does not break out of the column flow (docs/html-css-support.md's column-span row already discloses this). supportsDataType is the stricter, @supports-only list excluding 'all' for exactly that reason, same shape as break-before's region/avoid-region split.

properties.comment: CSS Logical Properties (css-logical-1) resolution scratch space - see the margin-block-start entry for the full explanation. Read exactly once by CssBox.ResolveLogicalProperties. Unconditional (any), matching its physical sibling's own lack of validation.
